title: docs: four pages walk operators through `os migrate organization-ownership` plan/apply with no 18.0 qualifier, and 18.0 refuses that command on every database (#24637, domain:devx row)
body:
Filing gate **④**: a per-lane child of the coordination parent #24637 (18.0 release text family). Each row is ①'s release-text exception. Filed by the triage seat (seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U`. ⛔ Not a claim. **Reader who acts:** the `domain:devx` seat, in one PR on the pages below.

## Rows

In 18.0, `os migrate organization-ownership` refuses plan and apply on every database (`ORGANIZATION_OWNERSHIP_UPGRADE_UNAVAILABLE`, `NOT_IMPLEMENTED`). On `origin/main` `f89d29e382`, these pages walk an operator through plan and apply with no 18.0 qualifier:
- `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx`: 5 hits, about `:200–222`, `:1027–1029` and `:1477–1494`, including the gate that "waits for a verified … --apply --plan-file run";
- `content/docs/concepts/metadata-lifecycle.mdx` (`:109`);
- `content/docs/permissions/capabilities.mdx` (`:220`);
- `content/docs/permissions/permission-sets.mdx` (`:399`).

**Done:** each passage either says what 18.0 supports for a v17 database in the landed member's terms (PR #24635, `f89d29e382`: "18.0 supports fresh installs only and does not upgrade a v17 database: keep a v17 database on a 17.x release until the 18.x release that carries the upgrade path."), or carries an 18.x qualifier where it describes the future ceremony. Census: `git grep -n -E "organization-ownership (--apply|--out|--dev)|--plan-file" -- content/docs`.

## Dedupe

The parent's searches cover these rows: MCP `search_issues` "organization-ownership command refused in 18.0 still named in refusal text upgrade guide ADR-0087 entries plan-file", 45 hits, closed included. The family members are #24566, #24567 and #23871, all closed. None covers the docs pages.
